pages.about: Pennyfeather & Co. started as a two-bench wooden toy workshop in 2022. We still make a small run of rattles and stacking toys each season, and we have grown the range steadily since as customers asked for more. Everything is chosen to survive being handed down.
pages.refund_policy: Unworn items with tags attached may be returned within 28 days of delivery for a full refund. Socks, bibs and underwear cannot be returned once opened for hygiene reasons. Toys may be returned within 28 days if unused and in original packaging. Return postage is paid by the customer unless the item is faulty.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders are picked and dispatched within one working day. Standard delivery is 3 to 5 working days by tracked post. Orders over 60 dollars ship free. We do not currently ship outside the United States.
